item.title: Her Phone Battery Was Found In Her Uncle’s SUV
item.description: Brittney Wood, a 19-year-old Alabama mother, vanished in May 2012. Days later, her uncle was found fatally wounded in his SUV, where investigators discovered her phone battery. Several relatives were later convicted in a separate child abuse investigation, but Brittney remains missing.

item.title: Her Mother Doubted His Guilt. A Retrial Acquitted Him
item.description: Tair Rada, 13, was found murdered in her school bathroom in Katzrin in 2006. Her mother questioned Roman Zadorov’s conviction. After 15 years in prison, he was acquitted at a 2023 retrial, with judges raising serious doubts about his confession. Her murder remains unresolved.

item.title: A Stolen Rental Truck Ended The Search For Denise Huber
item.description: Denise Huber, 23, vanished after a flat tire stranded her on a California freeway in 1991. Three years later, a tip about a suspicious rental truck led Arizona deputies to her remains inside a freezer. John Famalaro was convicted of her murder and sentenced to death in 1997.

item.title: Her Remains Contained Drugs Used To Tranquilize Deer
item.description: Suzanne Morphew, 49, disappeared in Colorado in 2020. Her remains, discovered in 2023, contained animal tranquilizers that prosecutors linked to her husband, Barry. He was charged again with first-degree murder in June 2025 and has pleaded not guilty.

item.title: A Pastor Was Charged 48 Years Later, Then Acquitted
item.description: Eight-year-old Gretchen Harrington disappeared while walking to Bible camp in Pennsylvania in 1975. Her remains were found two months later. Retired pastor David Zandstra was charged in 2023, but a jury acquitted him in January 2025 after his defense challenged an alleged confession.

item.title: His Wife And Girlfriend Were Found Dead In The Same Shed
item.description: In June 2017, police found Michael Bullinger’s wife, Cheryl Baker, his girlfriend, Nadja Medley, and her daughter, Payton, dead at an Idaho property. The pilot vanished, leaving a car at a Wyoming campground. Charged with three counts of first-degree murder, he has never been located.

item.title: They Entered The Wrong Home And Killed Egypt Covington
item.description: Singer Egypt Covington, 27, was killed in her Michigan home in June 2017 after intruders targeting her neighbor entered the wrong side of a duplex. Three men pleaded guilty to second-degree murder in 2023 and received prison sentences.
